messages:
maria_support: Customer acme-corp escalated. Their tool-call is failing in prod after we turned on json mode. Error shows missing nested key in function args; blocking checkout.

sam_engineer: paste runtime error + payload? repro steps?

maria_support: runtime error:
```
ERROR: invalid_function_args: missing key "order.items[0].sku" for tool "create_order"
request_id: req_0a1b2c3d
```

Request body (sanitized):
```
{ "tool": "create_order", "args": { "order": { "id": "ORD-5566", "items": [ { "name": "Widget A", "qty": 1 } ], "total": 19.99 } }, "mode": "json" }
```

maria_support: schema declares items[].sku required. Model-generated args omitted sku.

oliver_oncall: logs show model output omitted field vs null? need to know.

maria_support: logs-bot: model emitted truncated item object (no sku). Customer got 400 and their client retried causing 500 spike.

sam_engineer: repro locally -> same invalid_function_args. Steps:
1) POST /v1/tools/call with payload above
2) header X-Client-Id: acme-corp

sam_engineer: options: (A) clearer error with path, (B) lenient/coerce missing keys, (C) fallback to non-json tool mode.

aya_product: customer says SKU is optional on their side. Risk of changing schema to optional?

tess_research: model sometimes drops keys in single-item lists. Suggest sanitizer to fill defaults or nulls for missing required scalars.

maria_support: acme-corp acct_7788, started after rollout assist-policy-v3 on 2025-11-02T03:20Z.

deploy-bot: rollout assist-policy-v3 at 2025-11-02T03:20:57Z

oliver_oncall: temp mitigation: enable tenant flag "lenient_arg_parsing" for acct_7788 to accept missing nested keys and forward nulls.

sam_engineer: prepared patch to include offending path in error message. will canary.

aya_product: approve tenant toggle. do it now.

maria_support: customer offered workaround: switch to legacy non-json mode; they switched and checkout resumed.

oliver_oncall: flipping tenant flag now.

deploy-bot: tenant config updated acct_7788: lenient_arg_parsing=true

oliver_oncall: confirmed 200s on subsequent tests.

maria_support: will open postmortem and docs for required nested keys guidance. :white_check_mark:
